candidate_axiom.name: Landauer Thermodynamic Reversibility & Erasure Dissipation Accounting
candidate_axiom.statement: Every lossy state transformation that discards intermediate execution bits must formally account for entropy dissipation, enforcing logically reversible morphisms for all core state kernels.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: State mutations discarding intermediate histories without explicit dissipation audit channels or reversible inverse paths trigger compiler failure.

system_profile.topology_type: Logically Reversible Morphism Mesh with Dissipation Sinks
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Ingress State S] ──> [Reversible Transition delta] ──> [Egress State S']
                  │                                         │
                  └───> [Conservation Audit Ledger] ◄───────┘
                                       │
                                       ▼
                          [Entropy Dissipation Sink]

Reversible Morphism Kernel.role: Executes bijective transformations where each forward state transition has a computable backward inverse.
Reversible Morphism Kernel.invariant_rule: delta^-1(delta(S)) = S must hold without state loss.

Entropy Dissipation Sink.role: Explicitly buffers and audits all discarded microstate bits at module boundaries.
Entropy Dissipation Sink.invariant_rule: Bit-erasure events must log minimal thermodynamic accounting traces.

Microstate Invertibility Verifier.role: Proves that critical transaction histories can be rewound without relying on external snapshots.
Microstate Invertibility Verifier.invariant_rule: Irreversible side-effects inside core reducers are rejected.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Eliminates state destruction during recursive self-compilation (+0.0110).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Enables bit-exact state rewind and deterministic debugging across epochs (+0.0090).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Guarantees lossless message deduplication in Byzantine consensus (+0.0135).

tradeoffs.strengths: Provable zero data loss; mathematically reversible transactions eliminate rollback complexity.
tradeoffs.constraints: Reversibility tracking requires dedicated dissipation buffer channels.

leaderboard.name: Active Inference Generative Filter & Markov Blanket Isolation
leaderboard.statement: Subsystems must maintain internal generative models of their interface environments, executing state transitions that minimize variational free energy across insulating sensory and active Markov blankets.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Subsystems must interact strictly across sensory and active Markov blanket states by minimizing prediction error; uninsulated reactive coupling is prohibited.

system_profile.topology_type: Insulated Generative Model with Dual Blanket Boundaries
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Internal Generative State] ──> [Active Blanket (Actions)] ──> [External Domain]
               ▲                                                      │
               │                                                      ▼
       [Free Energy Minimizer] <── [Sensory Blanket (Observations)] <──┘

Internal Generative Model.role: Maintains probabilistic priors over anticipated environmental message distributions.
Internal Generative Model.invariant_rule: Updates prior weights autonomously via observed prediction errors.

Sensory-Active Markov Blanket.role: Provides formal statistical insulation shielding internal variables from external noise.
Sensory-Active Markov Blanket.invariant_rule: Direct RPC access bypassing blanket boundary triggers compile rejection.

Variational Free Energy Resolver.role: Adjusts internal state parameters to minimize divergence between predicted and observed payloads.
Variational Free Energy Resolver.invariant_rule: Prioritizes actions that resolve interface ambiguity.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Anticipates dependency resolution bottlenecks before compilation stalls (+0.0120).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Filters spurious telemetry noise via predictive suppression (+0.0085).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Mitigates network jitter and out-of-order packets via generative reconstruction (+0.0140).

tradeoffs.strengths: Proactive self-tuning resilience; shields subcomponents from external traffic spikes.
tradeoffs.constraints: Generative model inference incurs slight computational overhead on ingress.

leaderboard.name: Whiteheadian Event Concrescence & Prehension Directed Acyclic Mesh
leaderboard.statement: Architectural state must emerge strictly as a partially ordered sequence of immutable event concrescences (actual occasions); static mutable entities are prohibited in favor of explicit prehension causal graphs.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Static state objects without discrete event lineage or explicit prehension DAG ordering are rejected by the compiler.
leaderboard.domain: Process Metaphysics & Causal Graph Theory (Alfred North Whitehead)
leaderboard.principle: Concrescence of Actual Entities (Derived from L0-023)

system_profile.archetype: Epochal Concrescence Engine & Event Process Graph
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Past Actual Occasions] ──(Prehensive Ingest)──> [Concrescence Integrator]
                                                            │
                                                            ▼
                                              [Atomic Occasion Finalizer]
                                                            │
                                                            ▼
                                              [Immutable Historical Ledger]

Prehension Collector.role: Gathers causal influences from completed historical occasions across the DAG.
Prehension Collector.invariant_rule: Preserves strict causal partial ordering without temporal paradoxes.

Concrescence Integrator.role: Synthesizes competing inputs into an atomic, indivisible execution event.
Concrescence Integrator.invariant_rule: Atomic occasions execute with total transactional isolation.

Historical Horizon Ledger.role: Freezes finalized occasions into immutable anchors for future processes.
Historical Horizon Ledger.invariant_rule: Retroactive modification of historical occasions is prohibited.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Eliminates race conditions in concurrent self-synthesis pipelines (+0.0130).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Provides complete mathematical provenance for every telemetry assertion (+0.0095).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Guarantees Byzantine-tolerant causal ordering without distributed locks (+0.0150).

tradeoffs.strengths: Total immunity to state mutations and concurrency deadlocks; perfect auditability.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires periodic DAG snapshotting and compaction for memory reclamation.
